event.description: Canonical events: stop/turn_end/before_settle do not end a session; session_end and subagent_stop do. Native aliases are normalized by the CLI.

reason.description: Original host shutdown reason, retained on session_end.

tool_call_id.description: Native call identity; toolCallId/tool_use_id aliases accepted. Combined with host/session for runtime routing.

is_error.description: Host-observed failure only; isError alias accepted. Not executor proof.

kind.description: Host-observed session lineage, not an agent task declaration.

host_tools.description: Actual enabled tools for native fallback and delegated reviewer observation.

native_session_file.description: Host-observed native archive path for hash-verified review recovery.

structuredContent.description: Original Pi bash structured result; complete output, exit_code and truncation state are required for native command receipts.
